newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Corp Q1 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Corp Q1 loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Excluding the impact of the previously announced non-recurring items, consolidated operating income in the first quarter was $70.3 million compared to $114.7 million in 1996.
Frontier reported net income of $38 million and earnings per common share from normal operations of $0.23, consistent with First Call estimates.

As previously announced, the company recorded a Q1 $62.8 million post-tax charge to write off certain network costs. This charge was partially offset by an $11.2 million gain on the sale of Frontier's wireless interest in Alabama.
